predictions: Hey, alright, I got my third 20-correct-pick week last Wednesday! 20-5 for the week, to be exact. And two of my five incorrect picks were lost in dang 1001 tiebreakers! So nearly coulda really had something… And I even got my Trips Are For Kids pick right, so it really WAS a week, eh? That brings me to 144-55 (72.4% correct) for the season, and now I'm up to a lofty 2-6 with the Kids. Good thing I own most of the rest of you… well, not Vader so much… or McGavin or Ton 80 Proof…

Match of the week: (B Div.) Double In, Stumble Out @ Dart Attack. Ok, so, a race in B division is about to be reinvigorated. If Stumble wins this, the newly vibrant race will be for 1st place. But if Attack wins this, then the newly vibrant race will instead for 2nd place. If Stumble was playing with their full roster, I think I might lean their way. But since that hasn't happened yet this season, I'll go Attack, 13-11.

Match #2: (G Div.) Bottoms Up @ Dart Vader's. Huge wins by both of these teams last week have kept them both in the thick of the G title race. Interestingly, these are the only two G teams that have scored in double-digits in every week of the season so far. Bigtime showdown here. I always get Vader picks wrong, so happy them. Bottoms, 13-11.

Match #3: (F Div.) Sofa Kings @ Shark Shooters. Zero Dart is making it hard for more than maybe one team to get a shot at reeling them in this season. And Sofa/Rippin/Sharks are waging a three-way war to see which of them gets the lone shot (if there is one). Rippin got past the Sharks last week. Can Sofa this time around? Umm… yep, 13-11.

Match #4: (C Div.) Hump Day! @ Rif Raf. Don't look now, but Rif Raf (who has only surpassed 12 points twice all season, and those were only a 13 and a 14) has become a player in the C title hunt. This one was super tight last around, and I expect the same this time as well. As much as I like Rif Raf's 4-of-5 run, I'm going with Hump Day, 14-10.

Match #5: (E Div.) Dart Side of the Moon @ Death Throw. Dart Side has 3 more wins than Death Throw and rules the E roost, while Death Throw sits in 4th place at 0.500. And all this despite the fact that Dart Side only has 8 more points than Death Throw on the season. Maybe Death Throw gets the upset here? Or… maybe not. Dart Side, 14-10.

Matches #6 & #7: (D Div.) Sharky's Machine @ Red-eye Rangers; Ton 80 Proof @ Village Idiots. The 2-loss Rangers and Idiots line up against a pair of the dangerous 4-loss teams tonight. Do they win and close D down to a three-team race? Or do they lose and the focus shifts to a wide open free-for-all for 2nd place? I'm thinking it's time for it to be down to a three-team race. Rangers handle the Machine, 14-10; while the Idiots just barely escape Ton 80, 13-11.

Match #8: (G Div.) That's What She Said @ The Neighborhood Dart Knights. The Knights, the G leaders in ASPs, are somehow now down to 0.500 and a bottom half spot in the standings. If they were facing anyone else, I would bet on a rebound here. She, 14-10.

Match #9: (B Div.) Nine Lives @ Inconsistently Consistent. Two 4-4s, two 3-5s, and two 2-6s fill out the bottom three-quarters of B. And two of those teams are likely to drop to C in the fall. These two both average about 11.5 per week!! Just wow. Consistent? 13-11.
Match #10: (C Div.) Shooter McGavin @ The Outlaws. Some day Shane Murray will show back up, right? Even if he doesn't, is it time for a bit of upset action? Yeah, let's ride with the Outlaws, 13-11.

Match #11: (F Div.) Coach's Last Dance @ Triple Shot. If things hold to form next season, The Dartifacts are headed to G. And the loser of this one might well be joining them. I'll go with Triple, 13-11.

Match #12: (G Div.) 21 Dart Salute @ Darts and Crafts. The Crafts are 0-8 and an easy win, right? Well, they have 8-11 points in 6 of their last 7 matches, so I would say decidedly not. Crafts in a 1001!
